items.title: 4.2.4 Tree: Best for Hierarchical Data (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of when to use a tree (PDF 117-118).

blocks.text: Kab istemal karein: jab data hierarchical (oopar-neeche darjon wala) ho, yaani elements khud hi parent-child (maa-baap aur aulad jaise) rishte mein hon, to tree zaroori hai. Trees yahan istemal hote hain:

items: Hierarchical databases: organisations (idaron) ka structure, file systems, ya XML/HTML documents dikhana.
Binary Search Trees (BSTs): tez searching, insertion aur deletion ke liye.
Code ki banawat samajhna: compiler banate waqt trees code ko hisson mein tod kar us ki banawat samajhte hain, taake computer us ki qadam ba qadam instructions (hidayat) samajh sake.

blocks.prompt: Computer ka folder system tree kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Har folder ka ek parent (bahar wala) folder hota hai aur us ke andar kai sub-folders aur files ho sakti hain, aur sab ek root se shuru hota hai.

items: Tree: hierarchical data, search trees, compilers.
